cooling_description: Developer cites the site's cooler climate enabling efficient 'free cooling'; at pre-application stage cooling options were described as still under exploration, with tap-water cooling noted as the most common but water-intensive option. Definitive cooling technology not confirmed at PPP stage.
notes: Developer figure of ~34,000 m3/yr, described as equivalent to 239 homes; ILI states water would arrive via infrastructure separate from Auchtertool's network. Community council reported the existing mains pipe is too small and a new pipe would likely be required (Scottish Water Horizons involved). Discharge arrangements not disclosed — a key community council concern.
